description: Implementation of PackageManager class handling package download, installation, uninstallation, locking, telemetry, and notifications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package management functionalities including download, install, uninstall, lock, unlock, and telemetry within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a package downloader notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a package downloader notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the given service, sets up storage, telemetry, and download thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops download thread, and releases telemetry and service references.

methods.name: createStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager object via the current service.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager object.

methods.name: getCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Returns current timestamp in milliseconds for telemetry.

methods.name: recordAndPublishTelemetryData
methods.description: Records and publishes telemetry data for package events.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts a package download with specified options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified file locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Gets progress info for a download.

methods.name: GetStorageInformation
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space info.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package given its ID, version, and file locator.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Lists all installed packages.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration for a package.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Gets the installation state of a package.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an install notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an install notification callback.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock info for a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Gets configuration details for a package file.

methods.name: InitializeState
methods.description: Initializes internal package state from package implementation.

methods.name: downloader
methods.description: Thread function handling package downloads with retries and notifications.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves next download info from queue.
